name: treegrid
pattern: The APG Treegrid Pattern's cell-only focus configuration, adding two-dimensional roving-tabindex navigation and row expansion/collapse to a hierarchical native <table>
responsibility: Provide behavior, hierarchy ARIA, keyboard interaction, and state outputs without generating appearance/content. Use grid's focus model and Enter/toggle click/public APIs for expansion. When selection is enabled, Shift+Space/cell click/public APIs select rows and synchronize aria-selected/aria-multiselectable.

authorMarkup.root: A native <table> with data-controller="treegrid", named through consumer-authored aria-label or aria-labelledby

targets.row: A native <tr> in tbody with data-treegrid-target="row", positive-integer data-treegrid-level, and unique nonempty data-treegrid-value
targets.toggle: Optional native <button type="button"> inside a row for pointer expansion/collapse

authorMarkup.hierarchy: Represent hierarchy with flat <tr> rows and data-treegrid-level. The first row has level 1; later levels cannot exceed the previous level plus 1. HTML forbids nested <tbody>, so do not use nested DOM hierarchy. A row has children when the immediately following row is one level deeper.
authorMarkup.cells: Cells are native <td>/<th>, without rowspan/colspan spans and with equal cell counts across rows.
authorMarkup.content: The controller does not generate elements or content.

semanticElements: The root must be a named native <table>.
At least one row target is required, all HTMLTableRowElements inside the root.
data-treegrid-level must be a positive integer, starting at 1 and increasing by at most one from the preceding row. Level jumps are invalid.
data-treegrid-value must be nonempty and unique across rows.
Toggle targets must be native <button type="button"> elements inside rows.
Rows must have no spanning cells and must share the same cell count.
pageSize must be a positive integer, matching grid's rule.
selection must be none, single, or multiple.
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Validate on connection and row/toggle additions/removals. Invalid markup disables structural/operational attribute and state writes, keyboard handling, and public APIs, with one console.warn per connection and no completion warning. Restore enhancement when valid without repeating the warning. Do not throw.
contractValidation.warning: The standard enhancement-disabled warning includes a named native table, level/value rules, native button toggles, equal cell counts without spans, positive-integer pageSize, and none/single/multiple selection.

completion.warning: The completion warning lists the added attributes: "Added <attributes>. Include them in your markup." It is emitted once while connected, using a separate flag from the enhancement-disabled warning
completion.excluded: Do not write row/cell roles. Playwright ariaSnapshot measurements in all three engines retain tr=row and td=gridcell beneath table[role=treegrid]. Synchronize aria-level/posinset/setsize from level/structure and aria-expanded from state. Cell tabindex enables controller behavior. None of these produces completion warnings.

expanded.description: Array of initially expanded row data-treegrid-value values. Ignore leaf-row values.

pageSize.description: Number of rows moved by PageUp/PageDown, matching grid's rule

selection.description: Row-selection mode. none has no selection behavior, aria-selected, or data-selected, avoiding announcements that non-selectable rows are selectable.

selected.description: Array of initially selected row values. Ignore unknown values and normalize to DOM order. Ignore in none mode; use only the first in single mode.

expanded.description: Array of expanded row values. Assignment commits expansion without custom events. Ignore leaf-row values.

selected.description: Selected row values in DOM order. Assignment synchronizes selection, aria-selected, and data-selected without events, ignoring unknown values and using only the first in single mode. In none mode, the getter returns [] and the setter does nothing. Hidden rows can be selected.

expand(value).description: Expand a row without events. Do nothing for unknown values, leaves, or already expanded rows.

collapse(value).description: Collapse a row without events. Do nothing for unknown values, leaves, or already collapsed rows.

toggle(value).description: Toggle expansion without events. Do nothing for unknown values or leaves.

treegrid:beforetoggle.when: Immediately before expansion/collapse from trusted Enter or toggle click

detail.expanded: The open-and-close state about to be committed

treegrid:beforetoggle.effect: If prevented, preserve expansion, aria-expanded, hidden, and data-state, and do not emit treegrid:toggle.

treegrid:beforechange.when: Immediately before selection changes from trusted Shift+Space or cell click in single/multiple mode

detail.selected: Proposed selection set as row values in DOM order
detail.previousSelected: The selection set before the change

treegrid:beforechange.effect: If prevented, preserve selection, aria-selected, data-selected, and the selected value, and do not emit treegrid:change.

treegrid:change.when: After committing a trusted selection change

detail.selected: Committed selection set as row values in DOM order
detail.previousSelected: The selection set before the change

events.programmatic: expanded/selected setters, expand(), collapse(), toggle(), initialization, and reconnection emit no custom events.
events.synthetic: click/keydown with isTrusted=false emit no events.
events.nested: When receiving nested treegrids' events, restrict handling to the root with :self or event.target === event.currentTarget.

selection.modes: selection=single enables single selection and multiple enables multiple selection. Both retain role=treegrid and are configurations of one controller. none, the default, has no selection behavior. Expansion/navigation remain unchanged across selection modes.
selection.keyboard: Shift+Space selects the focused cell's row, following APG's cell-only row-selection mapping. single replaces selection and emits no event when the same row is already selected; multiple toggles. Prevent default page scrolling.
selection.pointer: Trusted cell clicks select rows. Exclude clicks whose path includes a toggle or an interactive button/a/input/select/textarea/label. single replaces selection and emits no event for the same row; multiple toggles.
selection.hiddenRows: Preserve selection of rows hidden by collapse. Hidden rows cannot receive focus/clicks, so only the public API can operate on their selection.
selection.excluded: Do not adopt Ctrl+Space column selection, Shift+Arrow cell-range extension, or Ctrl+A all-cell selection; these APG keys belong to cell selection. Provide row selection only.

editing: Cell editing and value commitment are outside controller scope. Compose editable and consumer controllers for editing lifecycle, key isolation, and focus return rather than duplicating drafts/validation/commitment. Do not propagate editing keydowns to treegrid. Preserve Enter in a parent row's first cell for expansion/collapse. See docs/plans/decision-grid-editing.md for composition and verification.

keyboard.focusModel: Use cell-only roving tabindex, not row focus. APG permits both models; this is intentional. Arrows do not expand/collapse, allowing grid's two-dimensional navigation.
keyboard.movement: ArrowRight/Left move within a row and ArrowDown/Up within the column among visible rows. Stop at boundaries without wrapping. Home/End move to row start/end; Ctrl+Home/End to first/last visible cells. PageDown/Up move pageSize visible rows. Exclude hidden rows. Reverse horizontal navigation in RTL using grid's rules.
keyboard.enter: When focus is in the first cell of a parent row with aria-expanded, Enter toggles expansion under APG's cell-only model. Do not handle Enter in other cells.
keyboard.arrowsDoNotToggle: Do not expand/collapse with arrows. APG's ArrowRight expansion and ArrowLeft collapse belong to the row-focus model, which this contract does not use.

root: role="treegrid", with a completion warning when supplied

managedMarkup.projection: Write row aria-level from data-treegrid-level, aria-posinset/setsize from siblings sharing a parent, and aria-expanded from expansion. Flat tables do not let the user agent infer these, so write necessary attributes without warnings. Do not put aria-expanded on leaf rows.
managedMarkup.selectionAria: Synchronize aria-selected without warnings in syncState, not structural applyStructure. In single mode, write true only on selected rows and omit it elsewhere. In multiple mode, write true/false on every row as specified by APG. Synchronize root aria-multiselectable="true" only for multiple mode, as configuration state without completion warnings, like listbox/combobox. Write none of these attributes in none mode.
managedMarkup.wiring: Write cell roving tabindex, 0 for current and -1 for others, as operational attributes without warnings.
managedMarkup.hidden: Set hidden on all descendants of collapsed rows and remove it on expansion. Do not use authored hidden as initial state; expansion is controller-owned.
managedMarkup.preservation: Preserve authored ids and all attributes except controller-owned aria-level/posinset/setsize/expanded/selected/multiselectable, tabindex, hidden, data-state, and data-selected.

stateOutputs.ownership: Controller-owned CSS state is parent-row data-state and, when selection is enabled, row data-selected. Do not require ARIA CSS selectors.
stateOutputs.selected: data-selected="true" for selected rows, absent otherwise, readable with tr[data-selected]. data-state expresses expansion; selection can coexist with expansion and therefore uses a separate attribute.
stateOutputs.leaf: Do not output data-state on leaves or the root. State belongs to individual rows, and consumers can derive aggregates with CSS :has().

lifecycle: Enable root click/keydown/focusin listeners and the cell childList/subtree MutationObserver only while connected; remove them in disconnect(). Do not duplicate registration on Turbo reconnection.
Reconcile row/toggle target connections/disconnections, recalculating hierarchy, ARIA, hidden state, selection, and roving tabindex.
Leave generated structural attributes and state outputs on disconnect().
On reconnection, normalize structural attributes and state outputs from current markup and expanded/selected values.

observations.item: Explicit row hierarchy, aria-multiselectable, and row selection announcements
observations.impact: Treegrid semantics, cell focus, and explicit aria-level are fixed independently of compatibility wording.

acceptanceCriteria: Required AAA criteria: 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception), with no pointer-only features; and 3.2.5 Change on Request, with controller focus movement limited to user actions or consumer JS calls, never timers.
The behavior and accessibility implemented by this component must meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
Support APG Treegrid cell-only focus, intentionally excluding row focus and arrow-based expansion/collapse.
Measurements in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit retain implicit tr=row and td=gridcell beneath table[role=treegrid], supporting omission of explicit row/cell roles.
Only trusted Enter/toggle clicks emit one cancelable beforetoggle followed by one toggle, in order; cancellation preserves state.
Public APIs, initialization, and reconnection synchronize state without custom events.
Collapse hides descendant rows, and keyboard navigation skips hidden rows.
Invalid markup disables enhancement with one warning
selection=none has no selection behavior, aria-selected, or data-selected; expansion/navigation behavior and tests remain unchanged.

When selection is enabled, aria-selected/multiselectable match the selection set, Shift+Space and cell clicks select rows, and cancellation/programmatic/synthetic event behavior follows the contract. Playwright ariaSnapshot measurements in all three engines expose tr aria-selected as row selected state.
Pass automated tests in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
Report real-device announcements of explicit row hierarchy and row selection through aria-multiselectable/aria-selected as unverified.

testMatrix.description: Hierarchy ARIA and expansion synchronization, role=treegrid completion, and no aria-expanded on leaves
Completion warning for missing attributes, no warning for complete markup, and separation from the invalid-markup warning
Two-dimensional navigation, Home/End, Ctrl+Home/End, PageUp/Down, RTL, hidden-row exclusion, and boundary stopping
Enter toggles only in a parent row's first cell, not other cells or leaf rows
beforetoggle cancellation/restoration, toggle detail/order/bubbling, and toggle-click reason
Descendant hidden synchronization, data-state, and nested collapse
Event suppression and state synchronization for expanded setter and expand/collapse/toggle
Warnings and disabled enhancement for invalid roots, level jumps, duplicate/empty values, non-button toggles, and spanning cells
Listener cleanup and normalization on disconnect/reconnect
No selection attributes in none mode; selected-row-only aria-selected in single; true/false and aria-multiselectable in multiple; data-selected
Shift+Space replacement in single mode, toggling in multiple, no-op on unchanged selection, and no handling of plain Space or none mode
Cell-click selection, toggle/button/link exclusion, and synthetic-click event suppression
DOM-order normalization of selected values, event-suppressed getters/setters, none-mode no-op, and hidden-row selection preservation
beforechange/change order, bubbling, detail, cancellation, keyboard/pointer reasons, and programmatic/synthetic event suppression

testMatrix: Engine-specific results for Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit
Screen-reader results on a real device (unverified)
